advice: No distinct cache-blocking experiment is justified from the supplied evidence. The measured source already uses a 64-row by 32-column traversal with the same K loops; a proposed row-half-first traversal was measured and not promoted. Other supplied traversal and panel-layout changes were also measured without repeatable gains. I abstain rather than repeat an alias or infer a cache bottleneck. No new blocks, pointer mapping, or expected speed effect are proposed.
risks: Changing traversal or packing can add input movement and alter cache behavior, but the evidence does not identify a cache bottleneck or show a reliable benefit. Any new layout also needs correct coverage of all output elements and fresh repeated paired controls.
